# Component index

<!-- GENERATED by skills/scripts/build-references.mjs — do not edit by hand. -->

Every published component, with the class it exposes, its React wrapper, and
whether it needs JavaScript. 28 components.

Read the `Docs` column before converting anything non-trivial: the guidance
page says when a component is the right answer and when it is not, which
this table deliberately does not duplicate. Append `.md` to any docs URL to
get the raw markdown.

## Needs JavaScript

These degrade without it, so they need `data-govbb-module` on the markup and
a single `initAll()` call after the document exists. Everything else is
CSS-only. React wrappers carry their own behaviour — do not call `initAll()`
over them.

- **File upload** — `data-govbb-module="file-upload"`
- **Header** — `data-govbb-module="header"`
- **Number input** — `data-govbb-module="number-input"`

## Components — Actions

### Button

Use buttons to help users carry out an action.

- Root class: `.govbb-button`
- React: `<Button>`, `<LinkButton>`
- JavaScript: not needed
- Docs: https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/components/button/
- Classes in `button.css`: `govbb-button`, `govbb-button--inverse`, `govbb-button--negative`, `govbb-button--secondary`, `govbb-button--tertiary`, `govbb-button--text`, `govbb-button-group`, `govbb-button-group--vertical`

## Patterns

Task-level guidance composing several components — how to ask for an address, how to let someone check their answers. 13 patterns. If the prototype is solving one of these problems, follow the pattern rather than assembling components from scratch: the pattern already encodes the question wording, validation and error handling.

### Ask users for

- **Address** — Ask for an address using separate fields for each line, country, parish and postcode. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/address/
- **Bank details** — Ask for the bank details a service needs to pay money to a user. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/bank-details/
- **Contact information** — Ask for the ways a service can contact a user, such as email and phone number. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/contact-information/
- **Disqualification** — Ask whether a user has ever been disqualified, and reveal the details when they have. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/disqualification/
- **Education** — Ask about a user's education level, institution and courses studied. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/education/
- **Employment** — Ask about a user's employment status, employer, role and dates. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/employment/
- **Endorsement** — Ask whether a user has a licence endorsement, and reveal the details when they do. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/endorsement/
- **ID** — Ask users for an identity document number, such as a National ID, passport or NIS number. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/id/
- **Name** — Ask for a person's name using title, first, middle and last name fields. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/name/
- **Personal information** — Ask for a person's date of birth, place of birth, nationality, sex and marital status. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/personal-information/

### Build forms

- **Forms** — Structure forms so people can understand, complete and recover from them. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/forms/

### Help users to

- **Check answers** — Let users review and change their answers before they submit. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/check-answers/
- **Declaration** — Let users confirm their information is correct before they submit. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/patterns/declaration/

## Templates

Whole-page scaffolds to start from. 12 templates. Patterns say how to solve a task; templates give you the page to fill in. Reach for one before hand-building a page shell — especially the error and interruption pages, which teams routinely forget a service needs at all.

### Authentication

- **Create an account** — The page where a new user registers for the service. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/create-account/
- **Reset password** — The page where a user asks for a link to reset their password. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/reset-password/
- **Sign in** — The page where a returning user signs in to the service. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/sign-in/

### Error pages

- **JavaScript disabled** — The message to show when a feature needs JavaScript and it is off. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/javascript-disabled/
- **Page not found (404)** — The page to show when a URL does not match anything on the service. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/page-not-found/
- **Problem with the service (500)** — The page to show when the service hits an unexpected error. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/problem-with-service/
- **Service unavailable (503)** — The page to show during planned downtime or maintenance. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/service-unavailable/

### Forms

- **Multiple questions page** — A form page for several closely related questions, like an address. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/multiple-questions-page/
- **Single question page** — The one-thing-per-page form scaffold - back link, error summary, one question, continue. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/single-question-page/

### Service pages

- **Confirmation page** — The success page shown after a user completes a service. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/confirmation/
- **Landing page** — The start page that introduces a service and sends users into it. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/landing/
- **Session expiry** — The page shown when a user's session times out mid-service. https://design-system.service.alpha.gov.bb/templates/session-expiry/
